items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Extracts resolve_head_sha/resolve_rollout_commit/shallow-clone guard/epoch re-verification into a new shared _rollout_resolution.py module, callable with a per-family epoch keyword; neither family's own GATE_ROLLOUT_AT_EPOCH, cache, or module identity changed. No shared rollout instant forced, as required by the follow-up card.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Pure git-plumbing relocation; _run_git's never-raise, fail-closed-to-None contract is unchanged and reused verbatim.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The trust-anchor ancestry check (trg-4380c61a) that defends against a forged backdated commit was moved without modification; the two dedicated forged-commit tests (one per family, plus a third in the new shared-primitive suite) still pass unchanged.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: All 64 pre-existing real-git behavioural tests pass unchanged (asserting resolved SHAs / None, never internals); added 12 new tests for the shared primitive using a THIRD, unrelated epoch to prove the epoch is caller-supplied, not hardcoded. One existing test's monkeypatch target was updated to the new call site (_rollout_resolution._run_git) per the Test-Update-Klausel, same assertion.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No change in subprocess/git-call count or shape; same sequence of git invocations, now in one shared function.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Follows the existing leading-underscore internal-module convention (_rollout_resolution.py alongside _project_gate_rollout.py / _layer_coverage_rollout.py). All three touched files are well under the 300-LOC guideline (127 / 162 / 266 lines).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; this is a same-process code-structure refactor with no producer/consumer pair.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings.
